mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. Tonight, we will see an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast. Under the Waxing Gibbous moon, look toward Mount Horeb at 4:11 AM tomorrow to see the International Space Station crossing toward Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects, and the Common Council has recently approved new utility rates to keep our sewer and stormwater services running smoothly.
There is plenty to do today, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the arena. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga.
In a report from last Friday, August 15, Verona police arrested a driver for an O W I after she was discovered unresponsive at the intersection of North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew, which you can enjoy at Culver's until they close at 10 PM. Also, make sure to visit Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park between 11 AM and 5 PM.
